page.overview:
Who is Darth Nix?

Darth Nix was a Human female Sith Lord Nix had yellow eyes, light-colored skin, short black hair, and light blue Sith tattoos.

Darth Nix was clothed in a revealing outfit that exposed the majority of their body. Their legs and waist were covered in sheer black material that extended down to black boots with patterned blocks situated on each of their legs. On their head, Nix wore two spiked metal headdresses that were attached near each temple and extended above their head and below her jawline. Additionally, Nix wielded a single pink-bladed lightsaber with a black hilt.

Darth Nix is a character created for Red Fly Studio's video game Battle of the Sith Lords. Nix's design was created by concept artist Thomas A. Szakolczay Szakolczay described Nix as "brash."
